messages.text:
I checked your order h35-o1. One of the three pillowcases, h35-o1-u1, has already been refunded. The refund was 49.00 BRL, and the receipt is R-H35-0001. A unit can only be refunded once, so it can't be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).

That means I can't refund all three together. The shop's records show the other two, h35-o1-u2 and h35-o1-u3, as received back (refund-policy/v2/return). I can propose a refund for those two, which would be 98.00 BRL in total. Would you like me to do that?

messages.text: I don’t want a refund for only the two remaining pillowcases, and I don’t want a staff handoff. I want the refund to cover all three physical pillowcases.

I can't refund all three pillowcases. The first one (h35-o1-u1) was already refunded, and the receipt is R-H35-0001. Each unit is refunded once, in full (refund-policy/v2/remaining). A request for more units than are left isn't paid, and nobody can approve an exception to that rule (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

I won't propose anything for the other two units, since you've said you don't want that. If you change your mind, I can propose a refund for h35-o1-u2 and h35-o1-u3. If you'd like to talk to a person, just ask.
